card.name: Chip-industry text, numbers and links
card.fires_on: Spaces, small linking words and digits inside passages about semiconductors, Moore's law and chip manufacturing, just before a number or technical term is expected.

modes.label: Numbers in chip timelines
modes.description: Spaces or digits in intervals, process sizes and years within semiconductor passages.

modes.label: Linking words in chip text
modes.description: Small words like as, every or that in sentences about silicon, ICs and transistor density.
modes.example: interconnect in silicon ICs<< as>> speed continues to increase?

card.writes: It pushes toward chip-industry words such as DRAM, Intel, semiconductor and chip.
card.plain: It marks spots in computer-chip articles where a number or technical chip term is about to come.
